description:
One day before her wedding, Ji-Yu finds her cheating boyfriend and calls off the engagement. She vents her grief by destroying her newlywed home and then meets the man living downstairs who's complaining about the noise. Then, drunkenly, she makes an impulsive offer...

 *"Will you hug me?" 

"If you keep going, I won't stop."*

The man's long fingers dug into her hair and their lips pressed together.

 *"From now on, don't miss a single thing and remember everything. I'll get mad if you say you don't remember because you're drunk."*

She thought it was just a fleeting impulse. But why was he here? 

*"I'm Cha Jae-Wook. Take care."*

The man downstairs, flirting in a sexy suit at the company she'd moved to to avoid her ex-boyfriend, starts flirting with Ji-Yu...

 *"Assistant Manager Yu Ji-Yu. Let's have an office romance."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
